page_title: PAR 2-2 INT | Parma v Inter 05/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Joaquin Correa (Inter) is booked for saying more than Daniele Doveri was willing to tolerate.
90+3' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) is adjudged offside.
90+2' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) was probably a bit loose with his words to Daniele Doveri, who decides to show him a yellow.

90+1' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) receives a yellow card for infringement.
89' The game is interrupted now, Nicola Zalewski (Inter) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
85' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
83' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Inter.
83' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. It will be a corner kick for Inter.

82' What a big chance! Marko Arnautovic (Inter) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
81' Masssimiliano Farris has decided to make a change. Marko Arnautovic (Inter) replaces Kristjan Asllani.
78' That will be all from Ange-Yoan Bonny who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Drissa Camara (Parma).
77' Half-chance! Joaquin Correa (Inter) plays a pass into the box, but Zion Suzuki reacts well to snuff out the attack.
76' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
74' Mandela Keita (Parma) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
74' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
73' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

69' 2 - 2 GOAL 2:2! Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
67' A cross from Giovanni Leoni (Parma) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
65' Masssimiliano Farris has decided to substitute Lautaro Martinez and he is replaced by Joaquin Correa (Inter).
65' Substitution. Hakan Calhanoglu is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).

65' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
64' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) meets a cross inside the box, but Yann Sommer wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
63' The game is interrupted as Marcus Thuram (Inter) is flagged offside.
61' Parma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

60' 1 - 2 Stunning strike! Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) latches on to a precise through ball from Enrico Del Prato before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 1:2.
59' Here is a change. Federico Dimarco is going off and Masssimiliano Farris gives the last tactical orders to Nicola Zalewski (Inter).
58' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
57' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sees a yellow card from Daniele Doveri after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
54' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) will replace Simon Sohm.
54' A cross into the box from Giovanni Leoni (Parma) is cleared.
53' Parma enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
51' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Masssimiliano Farris gives a chance to Carlos Augusto and Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is off.
46' The game is over for Hernani (Parma). Adrian Bernabe Garcia comes on for the second half.
46' Christian Chivu makes a switch. Mateo Pellegrino is coming on in place of Dennis Man (Parma) at the start of the second period.
46' Half-time substitution. Pontus Almqvist (Parma) is replaced by Giovanni Leoni.
46' Referee Daniele Doveri blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Daniele Doveri signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Inter players celebrate.
45+1' The Inter players halt their celebrations as referee Daniele Doveri makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' 0 - 2 Goal! Henrikh Mkhitaryan gets to the ball, slips Marcus Thuram (Inter) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 0:2.
44' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
43' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
41' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
40' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniele Doveri no option but to blow his whistle.
35' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Federico Dimarco (Inter), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
33' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

31' Matteo Darmian (Inter) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
29' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
28' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Pontus Almqvist (Parma), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
28' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Lautaro Martinez (Inter).
27' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
26' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
24' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

23' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
21' Parma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

20' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Dennis Man (Parma) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Yann Sommer pulls off a brilliant save. Parma force their opponents to concede a corner.
18' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Federico Dimarco (Inter) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.

15' 0 - 1 The goalkeeper makes a save but the ball rebounds off him out to Matteo Darmian (Inter). He finds himself some space inside the penalty area and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner, bouncing in off the post. A magnificent goal!

10' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Yann Sommer guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
9' Yann Bisseck (Inter) unleashes a powerful first-time volley towards goal, but the ball goes well wide of the left post.
7' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
6' Zion Suzuki makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Yann Bisseck (Inter) after a cross from the side.

4' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
3' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Inter will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniele Doveri.
